messages:
Ana Shah: Quick heads-up — CloudScale asked to list Redwood in Jakarta (ap-southeast5). They need: 1) marketplace SKU + SKUs for dedicated capacity, 2) quota reservation for 8xA100 equiv, 3) KMS flow for BYOK, 4) legal/data residency checklist. Target customer go-live 2026-06-01. Any blockers?

Chris Parker: Thanks Ana. Who owns the marketplace listing? @Evan (Partner Ops)?

Evan (Partner Ops): Yup I'll drive. Need the SKU spec from eng infra and a contact at CloudScale for their marketplace portal. @Suresh can you confirm the quota ask — 8 GPUs or do they want vCPU equivalent?

Suresh K: 8 x A100 eq is fine as a starting ask. We should include burst capacity of +20% for first 30d. Also need the region subnet/CIDR and whether customers will use private networking.

Ana Shah: CloudScale will do a public listing but customers in Indonesia require BYOK and local KMS integration. They provided their KMS endpoints: https://kms.cloudscale.id/docs. They asked for a walkthrough for integration.

GCP Partner Bot: marketplace-entitlement created: ticket #CS-4567. Action: partner-ops to upload SKU, infra to confirm quota. Link: https://partners.redwood/cs-4567

Chris Parker: For BYOK we need customer key import steps + HSM policy. @sec-team: any compliance blockers for Indonesia?

Suresh K: No known legal blockers but latency SLA needs confirmation. Recommend pinning model to quantized variant for ap-southeast5 to hit p95 < 150ms.

Evan (Partner Ops): I'll schedule a sync with CloudScale on Thursday 10am WIB. Also need legal to sign marketplace terms — cc @Leah (Legal).

Leah (Legal): I'll review the marketplace T&Cs today. Please attach the draft contract to the ticket.

Ana Shah: Uploading draft contract now. Also including a small capacity request to speed approvals:

```
region: ap-southeast5
requested_nodes: 4
gpu_type: a100-80gb
burst_pct: 20
start_date: 2026-06-01
notes: initial pilot with CloudScale channel partners
```

Suresh K: LGTM. Infra: can you pre-approve the namespaced SKUs so they don't get blocked by entitlement checks?

Chris Parker: I'll create namespace + SKU in staging and send the PR. Tagging @deploy-bot to run entitlement pipeline.

deploy-bot: entitlement-pipeline started for cs-jkt-sku, CI link: https://ci.redwood/entitlements/789

Evan (Partner Ops): Great. After infra confirm, I'll hand off to CloudScale for marketplace upload and KMS test. Everyone ok with the timeline?

Ana Shah: :thumbsup: if no objections I'll mark this as "Partner onboarding - Jakarta" and close the loop on the ticket next week.

Leah (Legal): :thumbsup: will update ticket with comments.

Chris Parker: Assigning action items in the ticket. Thanks team.
